[EN] Pay attention now—this isn't an operation for keeners. I've found an arena in Sand Wind Village where the kulkari force prisoners, slaves, and even other kulkari to fight monsters.

The worst is called {@LinkCreature:24#5001#Merkaratos}. We're going to kill it and deprive the buggers of their bloody fun. And by "we," I mean you and whoever you can convince to come along. Much as I want to join in the fun, I have another scouting mission to attend to.
[ES] Presta atención ahora: esta no es una operación para novatos. Encontré una arena en Sand Wind Village donde los kulkaris obligan a prisioneros, esclavos e incluso a otros kulkaris a luchar contra monstruos.

El peor se llama {@LinkCreature:24#5001#Merkaratos}. Vamos a matarlo y a privar a esos idiotas de su maldita diversión. Y con "vamos", me refiero a ti y a quien sea que puedas convencer para que venga. Por mucho que quiera unirme a la diversión, tengo otra misión de reconocimiento que atender.

[EN] Do you want your fellow soldiers captured and forced to fight to the death? Go kill Merkaratos.
[ES] ¿Quieres que tus compañeros soldados sean capturados y obligados a luchar a muerte? Ve a matar a Merkaratos.

[EN] I don't know how they caught it, but as long as it has victims to hunt, {@LinkCreature:24#5001#Merkaratos} isn't going anywhere.
[ES] No sé cómo lo atraparon, pero mientras tenga víctimas que cazar, {@LinkCreature:24#5001#Merkaratos} no irá a ninguna parte.
